correctness.rationale: The parity proof is airtight from the literal definition alone. The involution sigma(i,j)=(a+1-j,a+1-i) has fixed set exactly the anti-diagonal i+j=a+1. For every a>=2 the cell (1,a) is fixed and constrained (1!=a, so not exempted), forcing 2*pi_{1,a}=c, which has no integer solution for odd c; hence qtcpp_2(a,c)=0 for all a>=2 and all odd c. The argument uses only integrality of entries, so it is independent of monotonicity conventions and of 0- vs 1-based indexing. The concrete counterexample (a,c)=(2,1) gives 0 against the formula/table value 4. I independently re-executed inputs/artifacts/verify_parity.py and reproduced 0 at (2,1),(2,3),(3,1) plus nonzero even-height counts. The draft properly separates proved theorem, computational corroboration, and unclaimed corrected variants.

originality.rationale: The nearest prior result, Schreier-Aigner arXiv:2301.12272 Conjecture 4.2 with its Appendix A.2 table, predicts the opposite of the claim (nonzero values 4,7,24,... at odd c), so it contradicts rather than covers the zero theorem; its proved Theorem 1.2 concerns the anti-diagonal-free first-kind class, a different object. Extraction-wide full-text searches of that paper ('Conjecture 4.2','quasi transpose','qtcpp2') and of Inoue arXiv:2509.17064 ('second kind': zero matches; first-kind QTCPP/SPP bijection only) confirm no prior statement of diagonal-free parity vanishing. Classical TCPP/SPP/TSPP enumerations constrain different cell sets and cannot imply QTC2-diagonal-free zeros. Coverage is excluded by substantive contradiction and theorem-scope comparison, not by search absence.

value.rationale: As a TARGET resolution, the rigorous disproof is complete: an infinite refuting family (every a>=2, every odd c) plus the concrete witness qtcpp_2(2,1)=0 vs 4, which blocks the proposed six-vertex/Pfaffian proof route in principle since any correct model must reproduce the zeros. The object and invariant were motivated before computation (admitted target plus published conjecture), the zeros were unknown and contradict published data, and any future worker on Conjecture 4.2 needs exactly this fact. This is not a single-instance mismatch, table lookup, or relabeling: changing the exemption defines a different class, and the formula additionally fails at even c (verified (2,2): 4 vs 9), showing substantive falsity beyond a shift typo. No ADMISSION_DEFECT: the admitted target was a genuine conjecture, not a catchable vacuity.
